summary.en: When connecting AI tools to a database, I first wanted to know who could see what. Orders should be accessible for work while settlements retain their restrictions. I connected MCP Inspector to QueryPie Community and tested both.

summary.ja: AIツールとDBをつなぐとき、まず誰が何を見られるかが気になる。注文は参照し、精算は既存権限で保護したい。QueryPie CommunityへMCP Inspectorを接続して両方を試した。

title.en: [Part 25] Database Queries Through MCP Keep Existing Permissions — QueryPie Community MCP
